claim: Patchline ships an agent budget market allocating compute to highest-value repairs under a hard ceiling. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the budget market claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make agent-budget-market-gate`.
